expected_rows.study description: This study investigates the time-dependent gene expression response in earthworms exposed to ZnO nanomaterials and ZnO:Mn multicomponent nanomaterials. Three experiments were performed: Exp1 exposed earthworms to ZnO NM (7 days), Exp2 to ZnO:Mn MCNM (7 days), and Exp3 to ZnO:Mn and MnCl2 (14 days). Transcriptomics via RNA-seq was used to profile gene expression dynamics.

expected_rows.assay description: RNA-seq of Experiment 1 and Experiment 2 earthworm tissue samples performed at BMKGene (Muenster, Germany).
expected_rows.protocol: RNA extraction with TRIzol kit; RNA concentration measured by Nanodrop2000 spectrophotometer (Thermo), integrity by Agilent2100 Bioanalyzer LabChip GX (Perkin Elmer); poly(A) enriched library prep using Hieff NGS Ultima Dual-mode mRNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina (Yeasen; model:13533ES96) or VAHTS Universal V8 RNA-seq library preparation kit for Illumina (NR605); library inspected by Qsep-400; paired-end 2x150 bp sequencing on Illumina NovaSeq X.
expected_rows._evidence: L49-L50: BMKGene provider, TRIzol kit, Nanodrop2000, Agilent2100, library prep kits (Hieff NGS Ultima / VAHTS Universal V8), Qsep-400, Illumina NovaSeq X, PE150

expected_rows.assay description: RNA-seq of Experiment 3 earthworm tissue samples performed at GENEWIZ Germany GmbH (Leipzig, Germany).
expected_rows.protocol: RNA extraction with Qiagen RNeasy Mini kit (Qiagen, Hilden); RNA concentration measured by Qubit 4.0 Fluorometer (Life Technologies), integrity by RNA Kit on Agilent 5300 Fragment Analyzer (Agilent Technologies); poly(A) enriched library prep using NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina (NEB, Ipswich, MA); library validated by NGS Kit on Agilent 5300 Fragment Analyzer, quantified by Qubit 4.0; paired-end 2x150 bp sequencing on Illumina NovaSeq 6000.
expected_rows._evidence: L51-L53: GENEWIZ provider, Qiagen RNeasy Mini kit, Qubit 4.0 Fluorometer, Agilent 5300 Fragment Analyzer, NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit, Illumina NovaSeq 6000, PE150
